acceptance: A provisional positive result requires target timing improved on more than one event with no gross edit failure, then repeat second source+second seed. Claim of added mechanism requires superiority to simpler matched controls; no such claim if equal or if shifted negative control also works. Full success not guaranteed.
scope: Inference architecture intervention with frozen weights; do not call backbone architecture training or prove publication-level novelty.

amendment_before_formal_results.offset_control_interpretation: offset+4 may compensate inherent lag. It is a phase perturbation control, not assumed to fail. Improvement does not alone disprove temporal routing. If correct and positive offset both improve, add matched -4 offset and inspect signed phase response. Identical gains without signed phase effect weaken timing-specific interpretation.
amendment_before_formal_results.aggressive_screen: alpha1 radius0 all50layers all20steps is an aggressive screen. Failure rejects this setting, not all softer routing.

interpretation_constraints: Subsequent events in one clip are correlated; phase reset is not independent multi-event replication.
Mass-preserve outperforming hard mask may reflect restored reference-group mass, not a new architectural principle.
Residual-only route with one global static mean equals full-value route under fixed reference mass; no new mechanism from that algebra.
